about.lead: Self-hosted, single binary, no telemetry. Nothing here reports anything anywhere.
about.source: The code is open and the releases are signed. Nothing here talks to anybody but your forge.
app.name: LastHelp
app.tagline: Report a bug or suggest an idea. No account needed.
appearance.lead: Yours, not the server's. Everybody who opens this picks their own.
auth.passwordHelp: A long phrase beats a short puzzle. There are no rules about symbols.
auth.setupHelp: The first account is the administrator.
auth.usernameHelp: What you sign in with. It is never shown to anybody reporting.
backups.confirmRestore: Restore {file}? Everything written since it was taken is replaced.
backups.help: Taken as a consistent snapshot rather than copied out from under a running server, which is the difference between a backup and a file that looks like one. Keep it somewhere that is not this machine.
backups.lead: One file, and it is the whole thing: accounts, reports, votes, replies and settings.
backups.restoreHelp: Replaces everything with what was in the file.
backups.restoreWarning: Everything reported since that backup was taken is lost. There is no undo but another restore.
backups.restored: Restored. The old database was kept as {kept}. Restart the server to use the restored one.
board.empty: Nothing here yet. Yours would be the first.
error.accepts_nothing: A repository has to accept at least one of the two.
error.already_sent: That looks like something already sent. Look for it in the list.
error.bad_credentials: That email and password do not match.
error.bad_issue: That is not an issue number or URL.
error.board_closed: This repository has taken more today than a person can read. Try again later.
error.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete the account you are signed in as.
error.channel_incomplete: That channel is missing something it needs.
error.form_stale: This form went stale. Reload the page and send it again.
error.image_too_big: That image is too large. Under 96 KB, please.
error.internal: Something went wrong here. Try again.
error.issue_not_found: There is no issue with that number.
error.kind_not_accepted: This repository does not take that.
error.last_administrator: That is the only administrator. Make another one first.
error.no_forge: This organisation is not connected to a forge.
error.not_a_backup: That file is not a LastHelp backup this version can read.
error.password_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
error.password_too_short: The password needs at least 10 characters.
error.password_wrong: That is not the current password.
error.rejected: This repository does not take that.
error.too_many: That was a lot at once. Wait a moment and try again.
error.too_many_links: That has more links than a report needs.
error.update_bad_checksum: The download does not match the signed checksums. Nothing was installed.
error.update_bad_signature: That release is not signed by a key this build trusts. Nothing was installed.
error.update_container: This is running in a container, so replacing the binary would come back on the next restart. Pull a new image instead.
error.update_failed: The update did not finish. Nothing was replaced.
error.update_none: There is nothing newer to install.
error.update_offline: Outbound connections are switched off, so nothing was checked.
error.update_too_old: That release is older than this database and would not understand it.
error.update_unreachable: Could not reach the release server.
error.update_unverifiable: This build has no release keys, so it cannot verify an update. It will not install one.
error.update_wont_run: The downloaded binary did not run on this machine, so it was not installed.
error.username_taken: That username already has an account.
form.bodyPlaceholder: What happened, and what you expected instead
form.emailHelp: Only to tell you when this changes. Leaving it blank is fine.
form.similarHelp: Voting for one of these helps more than a second copy.
form.title: Title
item.commentWaiting: Sent. A person will read it before it appears.
item.merged: This was merged into another report.
landing.emptyOperator: Nothing is set up yet — and you are the administrator, so that is one short form away.
landing.pointForge: What deserves it becomes a real issue in your forge, and the report follows it when it closes.
landing.pointNoAccount: Reporting needs no account. A title, a description, and that is the whole form.
landing.pointVotes: Ideas gather votes, so what people actually want stops being a guess.
org.forgeLead: The token is stored encrypted and never shown again. It only ever needs to write issues.
org.noForgeLead: No forge, so there is nothing to connect. Reports live here and nowhere else, which is a perfectly good way to run this.
org.tokenWhere: In that forge: {where}, with the scope {scope}.
organizations.confirmDelete: Delete {name}? Its repositories, every report in them, the votes and the replies go with it. This cannot be undone without a backup.
organizations.confirmDeleteRepo: Delete {name}? Every report in it, the votes and the replies go with it. This cannot be undone without a backup.
organizations.lead: An organisation groups repositories and holds one connection to a forge.
organizations.noRepositories: No repositories yet. Add one and people can start reporting.
overview.emptyLead: Nothing has been reported yet. The numbers fill in as people use it.
panel.addressHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. It goes in the URL and cannot be changed later.
panel.channelHelp: Without this, the queue fills and nobody notices. That is how a portal dies.
panel.firstStep: Nothing here yet. Add an organisation to start — it is a connection to a forge, or to nothing at all.
panel.forgeHelp: Where issues are opened. A repository here works perfectly well without one.
panel.forgeOwnerHelp: The account or organisation that owns the repositories, spelled as the forge spells it.
panel.forgeRepoHelp: Only the repository name. The owner comes from the organisation.
panel.forgeURLHelp: The address of the forge itself, with no path after it.
panel.issueQueued: Queued. It will appear on the forge shortly.
panel.mergeHelp: Its votes move across, and anybody who voted both counts once.
panel.mergePlaceholder: The identifier of the surviving report
panel.name: Name
panel.nameHelp: What people see. You can change it later.
panel.tokenHelp: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Needs permission to read and write issues.
people.addHelp: They arrive with no access to anything. Give them a role in an organisation or a repository afterwards.
people.confirmDelete: Delete the account {name}? What they wrote stays; the account does not.
people.editHelp: Leave a box empty to leave it as it is.
people.lead: Everybody who can act here was put here by somebody who already could. There is no public sign-up.
people.newPasswordHelp: Set one only if they cannot sign in. They are not asked for the old one.
people.roleHelp: An owner runs an organisation and holds its forge token. A collaborator triages one repository and never sees it.
people.rolesHelp: A role is given in one place. Somebody who helps with one repository has nothing in the one next door.
personalization.accentHelp: The house orange is the default. Changing it changes buttons, links and highlights.
personalization.lead: The name, the mark and the colour this installation wears. Everybody who opens it sees these.
personalization.logoHelp: Small and square reads best beside the name. Under 96 KB.
portal.empty: Nothing has been set up here yet.
profile.name: Display name
profile.nameHelp: Shown beside your replies. Leave it empty to be shown as the team.
profile.passwordHelp: Changing it ends every other session of this account, including on other machines.
repo.acceptsHelp: At least one. You can change this later.
repo.acceptsLead: Both, unless you have a reason. A repository that accepts neither is refused.
repo.lead: One repository, one place for people to report. You decide what becomes an issue.
roadmap.lead: Nobody keeps this by hand: it follows what actually happens.
sent.keepLink: Keep this link. It is the only way back to your report, and it is not shown again.
sent.title: Sent
sent.waiting: A person will read this before it appears.
setup.doneLead: The administrator account exists and the installation has a name.
setup.doneNext: The installation is configured. What comes next is an organisation: a place to group repositories, and where the connection to your forge lives.
setup.instanceLead: It goes in the header and the browser tab. Leave it empty to keep LastHelp.
setup.instanceNameHelp: Usually who runs it rather than what it does.
setup.languageLead: Pick the language and the look. Everyone who opens this can pick their own; this is the default.
setup.orgLead: An organisation groups your repositories and holds the connection to your forge. One is enough to start.
setup.pictureHelp: Optional. It is shown beside your replies, so people can tell the team apart.
shell.publicBoard: See it as everybody else does
update.channelHelp: Betas arrive earlier and are meant to be run by people who will report what breaks.
update.installing: Installing. This page will come back when it restarts.
update.title: Updates
